Container.Name: photography
Container.Overview: Album Layout Studio. Public GHCR image; no pull credentials. Runs as UID/GID 1000:1000. Original photographs are read-only. One backend; LAN/Tailscale only. WUD watches timestamped releases; arrange consistent database/thumbnail backups before updates.

Config.Name: SQLite data
Config.Description: Persistent SQLite state. Writable by UID/GID 1000:1000; back up stopped together with thumbnails.

Config.Name: Managed thumbnails
Config.Description: Writable by UID/GID 1000:1000. Back up and restore with the matching SQLite checkpoint.

Config.Name: Original photographs
Config.Description: Independent original-photo collection. Read/traverse access for UID/GID 1000:1000; never writable by this application.

Config.Name: WebUI port
Config.Description: LAN/Tailscale only; do not forward publicly. Preserve browser origin for remembered identity and drafts.
